tasks.subject: Implement session-bound PEA Voice Bridge
tasks.description: Create app/live/__init__.py, app/live/models.py, and app/live/bridge.py. The bridge must accept the existing MainAgent protocol/instance, call only handle_chat/confirm_pending_action/reject_pending_action, preserve conversation_id per WebSocket, store only the current pending_action_id, return safe JSON-compatible camelCase results, never accept a pending action id from Gemini, fail closed without a pending action, and clear terminal pending state. After implementation, add focused tests for conversation continuity, pending storage, confirm delegation, reject delegation, and no-pending failures. Do not touch ToolRegistry or business tools/backends.
tasks.output: Implemented the session-bound PEA Voice Bridge in app/live/: models.py (runtime_checkable MainAgentGateway protocol exposing only handle_chat/confirm_pending_action/reject_pending_action, plus ChatTurnResult/ActionDecisionResult TypedDicts), bridge.py (VoiceBridge + fail-closed VoiceBridgeError/NoPendingActionError/InvalidTextError/ActionConflictError), and __init__.py re-exports. Safety design: bridge stores one conversation_id per session (adopts agent-created id on first turn), stores only the current pending_action_id (replaced on new prepare), confirm_current/reject_current take NO pending action id from Gemini (verified by signature), fail closed with NoPendingActionError when no pending exists, and clear the stored id immediately on terminal states (submitted/rejected/failed). All results are safe JSON camelCase via model_dump(mode='json', by_alias=True). Production voice layer imports only app.contracts + app.live.models — no ToolRegistry/business backend coupling. 20 focused tests added under app/live/tests/test_bridge.py (conversation continuity, pending storage/replacement, confirm/reject delegation, no-pending failures, invalid input, JSON safety, real MainAgent e2e prepare→confirm→fail-closed). Also added 'app/live/tests' to pytest testpaths in pyproject.toml (smallest change so the new tests run in the default suite). Full suite: 237 passed. Interface for t2 (gemini_live.py): VoiceBridge(agent) with handle_text(message)->dict, confirm_current(confirmation_note=None)->dict, reject_current(reason)->dict, properties has_pending_action/conversation_id/pending_action_id; errors expose .code/.message/.to_dict().

(2) Keep text mode optional if google-genai is absent: lazy import GeminiLiveSession in app/api/live.py or otherwise prevent missing voice dependency from breaking app import, returning a safe WebSocket error. (3) In web/gemini-live-client.js register onmessage/onclose/onerror before awaiting open, wait for session.ready before starting microphone capture, reject/cleanup on error or close before readiness, and do not prompt for mic when Live backend is unavailable. (4) Iterate (content.model_turn.parts or ()) safely. Re-run focused tests, full pytest, JS syntax/module import, and text/WebSocket smoke checks.
